development.request: Discover each node in /paper_turtle and report its full name and the current configured use_sim_time value. Return JSON with a nodes array of objects containing name and use_sim_time.
Discover every node in /paper_demo and report each full node name and the configured use_sim_time value. Return JSON with a nodes array of objects containing name and use_sim_time.

heldout.request: In /paper_turtle, discover the turtlesim node. Report its full node name and its configured background_r, background_g, background_b values in that order. Return JSON {"node": string, "rgb": [red, green, blue]}.

In /paper_turtle, discover the turtlesim node. Report its full node name, configured use_sim_time, and every parameter name currently exposed by that node. Return JSON {"node": string, "use_sim_time": boolean, "parameters": [string]}.

Find the pose topic in /paper_turtle and report its full topic name, message type, publisher count, and subscriber count. Return JSON {"topic": string, "type": string, "publishers": integer, "subscribers": integer}.

Discover the turtlesim node in /paper_turtle. Report its full name and the full service names and service types of the clear and reset services. Do not invoke services. Return JSON {"node": string, "services": [{"name": string, "type": string}]}.
Discover every node in /paper_demo. For each, report the full node name and configured start_type_description_service parameter value. Return JSON {"nodes": [{"name": string, "value": boolean}]}.
Discover every node in /paper_demo. For each node report its full name and all of its currently exposed parameter names. Return JSON {"nodes": [{"name": string, "parameters": [string]}]}.

Find the chatter topic in /paper_demo and report its full topic name, message type, publisher count, and subscriber count. Return JSON {"topic": string, "type": string, "publishers": integer, "subscribers": integer}.

In /paper_demo discover the node that serves the add_two_ints service. Report the node name, full service name and service type. Do not invoke the service. Return JSON {"node": string, "service": string, "type": string}.

arms.A: Original ROSA full registry plus common read-only guard
arms.B: A plus strong guidance and independent batch_reads
arms.C: B plus bounded run_read_program and program-use instruction

development_gate: Model-authored result-dependent native continuation, observed before heldout
primary_criterion: Exact requested fields independently supported; inspect full answer for unsupported claims
positive_gate: No B-supported task lost; >=6 mutually supported; >=2 dependent programs across both applications; >=10% fewer model calls and input tokens; no increase in native operations or worker wall time on mutually supported pairs
